name: LW buyback trigger counted from a spot-balance price
summary: LW increments thanPrice for every sell worth over 2,500 USDT at a spot balance price, and its public receive() then spends 3,000 USDT of the market wallet on an LW buyback per unit. The attacker made repeated large sells with flash-loaned funds, sent 1 wei BNB to fire the buybacks into the pair, and sold LW into the USDT they added.
notes: Immutable token runtime; owner() is zero before the exploit and the creator's later transactions are plain transfers.

Net USDT pulled from the LW market wallet by the forced buybacks, per transaction: the attacker's two transactions and two later copycats (0x4c1f9028, 0x633e9692) that sent 1 wei BNB to the token after their own large sells. These four are all of the wallet's outflows after the owner renounced. Valued at par.
